The superseded launch anchor is preserved below and remains intact in state/anchors/launch_anchors.json and program.md 2; per-dataset floor arms stay the mandatory reported columns on every model card.
caveats: This is a MECHANICS anchor (cratered-rule comparand for later r3s2 batches), NOT an adjudicated claim: round-3 success criterion 1 additionally requires exceeding the condition->level closed-form law by >= 1 CERTIFIED mce on >= 2 scored datasets, and state/anchors_repaired/noise_floor.json is still PROVISIONAL pending r3s4 certification.

The scored arm does NOT beat the training-free stage ladder anywhere: on ac/fk/ch/ifc_heat trained and closed-form are indistinguishable (ratio 0.9985-1.0009) and on ifc_poisson the closed-form S1_gain beats it every seed (0.1049/0.0764/0.1711 vs 0.1478/0.1250/2.0409 nRMSE).
ifc_poisson and ifc_heat both LOSE their mandatory affine_on_hf_train floors (1.5938 / 0.9584) and their nn_condition floors on the 3-seed mean; the panel win is carried entirely by ac/fk/ch.

Seed 2's ifc_poisson stage-2 instability (skill 56.6926 vs 4.1060/3.4731) drives the upper CI bound; the same instability is present in the E0 replay arm and in the round-2 record (r2s2_stacked-B1 seed 2).

Standing panel caveats apply: fisher_kpp weak fidelity gap, allen_cahn trimmed test n=78, cahn_hilliard outlier domination, ifc_poisson exactly-affine condition->HF map, pfc report-only (ADR r3-0004), no cross-round comparison without the honest-denominator flag.
